item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
item.description:
GitHub’s Xcode 27 runner image for GitHub-hosted macOS runners now runs on macOS 27 and is available in public preview. This lets you validate Apple apps against macOS 27 using that runner image.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub-hosted macOS runners now support Xcode 27 in public preview, letting you build and test Apple apps against the latest Xcode version. This is an early-access runner image release.

  • Source: GitHub
